title: Identifier
description: A locally-unique identifier for this node.

title: Name
description: A name for this node. The name should be unique amongst the nodes belonging to a network.

title: Status
description: The status of this node, from the closed [nodeStatus codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodestatus).

title: Location
description: The physical location of this node.

title: Address street address
description: The physical address of this node. | The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

title: Address locality
description: The physical address of this node. | The locality. For example, Mountain View.

title: Address region
description: The physical address of this node. | The region. For example, CA.

title: Address postal code
description: The physical address of this node. | The postal code. For example, 94043.

title: Address country
description: The physical address of this node. | The country in which the address is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

title: Type
description: This node's function, from the open [nodeType codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodetype). For nodes with multiple network providers, the union of the node types for each provider. If a node's only function is to serve as a junction between spans, this attribute should be omitted. Junction nodes are identified by the existence of more than two spans that begin or end at the node.

title: Type
description: The type of supporting infrastructure, from the open [nodeSupportingInfrastructure codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodesupportinginfrastructure).

title: Description
description: A description of the supporting infrastructure for this node.

title: Spare capacity
description: Whether the supporting infrastructure has spare capacity for the installation of additional network equipment.

title: Access point
description: Whether active or passive transmission equipment is installed at this node which is capable of providing access to the network.

title: International connections street address
description: The international connections available at this node. For all connections, `.country` is required. | The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

title: International connections locality
description: The international connections available at this node. For all connections, `.country` is required. | The locality. For example, Mountain View.

title: International connections region
description: The international connections available at this node. For all connections, `.country` is required. | The region. For example, CA.

title: International connections postal code
description: The international connections available at this node. For all connections, `.country` is required. | The postal code. For example, 94043.

title: International connections country
description: The international connections available at this node. For all connections, `.country` is required. | The country in which the address is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

title: Power availability
description: Whether power for active network equipment is available at this node.

title: Technologies
description: The active technologies used at this node, from the open [nodeTechnologies codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodetechnologies). For nodes with multiple network providers, the union of the active technologies used by each provider.
